import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': [np.nan, 'C', np.nan, 'C', np.nan],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and gender
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Class and Gender')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class & Gender')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(title='Survived')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for survived_status in df['alive'].unique():
    subset = df[df['alive'] == survived_status]['age'].dropna()
    color = '#2ecc71' if survived_status == 'yes' else '#e74c3c'
    ax2.hist(subset, alpha=0.5, label=f'{survived_status}', color=color, bins=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend(title='Survived')

# 3. Fare vs Age colored by survival
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], c=df['survived'], 
                      cmap='coolwarm', alpha=0.8, s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax3.set_title('Fare vs Age (Colored by Survival)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Survived (0=No, 1=Yes)')

# 4. Survival rate by passenger class
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
class_survival = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(class_survival)), class_survival.values, 
               color=['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22'])
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(class_survival)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(class_survival.index)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, v in enumerate(class_survival.values):
    ax4.text(i, v + 0.02, f'{v:.2f}', ha='center', fontweight='bold')

# 5. Family size distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_counts = df['family_size'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax5.bar(family_counts.index, family_counts.values, color='#1abc9c')
ax5.set_title('Family Size Distribution')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
for i, v in enumerate(family_counts.values):
    ax5.text(family_counts.index[i], v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center')

# 6. Embarkation port analysis
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
embark_data = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax6.set_title('Survival by Embarkation Port')
ax6.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.legend(title='Survived')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
